notes.fixed: The enforced eager cap includes JS-enabled entry/static-import JS and eager stylesheets. Noscript-only standalone CSS is excluded there, but included in its own gate and the PWA core. HTML, including active inline CSS, is reported separately. Existing PWA metadata reservations are unchanged.
notes.provisional: App CSS and largest-lazy caps remain ceil(270f observed value * 1.05). Standalone CSS uses ceil(574 raw / 314 gzip9 * 1.05), separately authorized when S3 introduced that class. Combined CSS totals remain reported.
notes.compression: gzip level 9, independently per file, summed after deduplication. Fonts, JSON and the root worker are not part of the eager JS+CSS gate.
notes.lazy: All emitted assets/*.js outside the eager set; raw and gzip maxima are measured separately. The root service worker is excluded.
notes.cssScopes: App CSS is Vite-emitted assets/*.css. Standalone pwa/*.css may only be linked from pwa/offline.html or index.html noscript, never an app chunk or CSS import, and must be in the bounded PWA core. Active inline styles are reported in the full HTML raw/gzip measurements rather than silently added to or removed from the emitted-CSS baseline series.
